_note: The 40 named crew who appear as veterans (design doc, Crew and staff: Hiring) and the name lists rookies are drawn from, by continent. favorite is the branch (flight crew) or staff path a veteran has grown first.

named.name: Amara Okafor
named.bio: Flew mail runs across the Sahel before dawn for six years. Says the stars are better company than the radio.

named.name: Kai Moreno
named.bio: Learned to fly gliders over the Mojave and still treats every drop of fuel like borrowed money.

named.name: Ingrid Halvorsen
named.bio: Has landed on every fjord strip in Norway and knows each one's crosswind by first name.

named.name: Rafael Duarte
named.bio: Ferried planes to four continents in a single year and kept a postcard from every stop.

named.name: Mei Lin Zhou
named.bio: Won her first plane in a raffle. Everyone else on the crew insists that explains a lot.

named.name: Tomasz Wrobel
named.bio: Thirty years in the left seat and a notebook of checklists he hands to every new first officer.

named.name: Grace Mwangi
named.bio: Gives the cabin announcement a little extra sparkle. Passengers ask for her flights by name.

named.name: Hamish Ross
named.bio: Started as a bush pilot hauling supplies to the islands and never lost the knack for a tight load.

named.name: Lucia Ferrante
named.bio: Plots ocean crossings with a pencil first and a computer second, and is usually right about the pencil.

named.name: Arjun Mehta
named.bio: Finds the gap in the weather nobody else saw. Calls it intuition; the crew calls it luck.

named.name: Sofia Andersson
named.bio: Knows every beacon between Stockholm and the Arctic Circle and can land in pea soup.

named.name: Kwame Asante
named.bio: Prefers the overnight legs, when the airways are quiet and the tailwinds are free.

named.name: Yuki Tanaka
named.bio: Taught navigation at the flight school in Osaka and still grades everyone's routes.

named.name: Diego Herrera
named.bio: Grew up between Andean airstrips and can read mountain weather from the window.

named.name: Nadia Petrova
named.bio: Charted polar routes for cargo outfits and somehow made friends at every refuelling stop.

named.name: Chloe Dubois
named.bio: Ran the first-class cabin on the Paris to New York run. Remembers every regular's coffee order.

named.name: Mateo Silva
named.bio: Brings pastel de nata from his aunt's bakery for every flight out of Lisbon.

named.name: Aisha Bello
named.bio: Sold more duty free on one Lagos to London flight than the shop did all week.

named.name: Liam O'Connor
named.bio: Keeps the cabin calm on red-eyes with tea, blankets and very quiet jokes.

named.name: Hana Kim
named.bio: Speaks five languages and is working on a sixth, one long-haul at a time.

named.name: Olivia Bennett
named.bio: Trained half the cabin crew in Sydney. Still checks your name badge is straight.

named.name: Ravi Shankar
named.bio: Former hotel concierge who treats a 40-minute hop like a five-star stay.

named.name: Theo Lindqvist
named.bio: Can fit a piano, two bicycles and a canoe into a hold built for one of them.

named.name: Fatima Zahra
named.bio: Moved museum pieces between Casablanca and Paris without a single scratch.

named.name: Bruno Costa
named.bio: Grew up on the Rio docks and still counts crates in his sleep.

named.name: Ewa Nowak
named.bio: Balances a hold to the kilogram by eye and double-checks it anyway.

named.name: Samuel Osei
named.bio: Ran the cargo apron at Kotoka for a decade and trained every forklift driver there.

named.name: Jack Thompson
named.bio: Has packed vaccines, violins and one very nervous racehorse.

named.name: Leila Haddad
named.bio: Runs the overnight freight bank like clockwork while the city sleeps.

named.name: Margaret Okoye
named.bio: Turned a sleepy regional terminal into the busiest hub in the province.

named.name: Henrik Berg
named.bio: Never met a departure board he couldn't fit a few more flights onto.

named.name: Carmen Ruiz
named.bio: Rolls out the red carpet herself when someone famous is flying.

named.name: David Cohen
named.bio: Puts up posters for new routes before the planes have even landed.

named.name: Ana Lucia Vargas
named.bio: Ran three airports at once during the Andes winter and kept every board full.

named.name: Kenji Watanabe
named.bio: Keeps the VIP lounge stocked with the best green tea in Kansai.

named.name: Priya Nair
named.bio: Can rebook a missed connection faster than the passenger can find their boarding pass.

named.name: Omar Farouk
named.bio: Knows a gate agent at every airline in Cairo and trades favours like currency.

named.name: Elena Popescu
named.bio: Has reunited more lost bags with their owners than anyone in Europe.

named.name: Marcus Johnson
named.bio: Runs the transfer desk at the busiest hub in the Midwest with a whistle and a grin.

named.name: Zanele Dlamini
named.bio: Makes every connecting crew feel at home with coffee and the latest weather.
